title: TowerRoster
description: Tower definitions. The projectile block is deliberately wider than any current tower uses (homing, pierce, explosion, effects) - the scaffolding ships before the features so that balancing and effects later are data changes, not migrations. range is in cells; fireEveryTicks at 20 Hz.

short.description: The name the strip's button shows under the sprite (session 25): at most nine glyphs. Absent = the name, cut.

desc.description: One sentence for the build card and the catalogue: what it is and what it answers.

minRange.description: Cells. Enemies closer than this are never targeted - the dead zone (PRD sec 5.3, the Mortar). Absent = 0.

aura.description: Support towers (session 26, the Bastion): every tower within reach cells gets these multipliers; the strongest of each kind applies when several supporters overlap.

coreBoon.description: The tower's unique gift when it stands next to the Core face (PRD sec 4.5, WBS 2.35): additive mods like a tier, plus rule flags. Every tower has one.

beam.description: attack:beam only (session 26, the Laser Lance; WBS 2.34): a corridor width cells wide down the tower's facing for range cells; every body in it takes the damage each fire; holding one lead target heats the beam by rampStep per fire up to rampMax times the damage.

chain.description: attack:chain only (session 25, the Tesla Coil): the arc hits count bodies, each within reach cells of the last, at falloff of the previous hop's damage.

projectile.description: Required for attacking towers; absent on attack:none producers (Refinery).

speed.description: Cells per tick. Must comfortably outrun enemies.

homing.description: Tracks its target. false = straight shot that can miss.

homingTurnRate.description: Radians per tick of steering when homing. Reserved.

pierceCount.description: Enemies a piercing shot passes through. Reserved.

explodeRadius.description: AoE radius in cells on impact. Reserved (Mortar).

applyEffect.description: Status effect id applied on hit (slow, burn, ...). Reserved.

damageType.description: What its hits are (session 26, PRD sec 8): kinetic or energy. Enemies multiply damage by their resist entry for the type. Absent = untyped (producers).

attack.description: projectile fires shots; pulse hits everything in range on cooldown (no projectile); none never attacks (producers).

production.description: Resource yield per cycle (Refinery). Ore counts only while the tower stands on an ore cell - engine rule, PRD sec 5.3. scrap is reserved shape for the foundry relic (PRD sec 7.4); no shipped tower uses it.

everyTicks.description: Cycle length in ticks at 20 Hz.

tiers.description: Tower Dominion-style tree: 3 tiers, each an either/or choice, mutually exclusive, unlocked in order. 2+4+8 = 14 tower variants.

desc.description: One written sentence: what this choice DOES, in play terms (WBS 2.10 - every purchase is explained before it is bought). Shown on hover in the inspector.

unlocks.description: Capability grant: surveySpeed accelerates all prospect jobs (stacking per tower); surveyAuto prospects nearby rock autonomously; ignoreArmor makes the tower's hits ignore armour; deepBore50 / deepBore100 grow the vein under the tower by 50% / 100% when chosen (one-time).

minRange.description: Additive dead-zone delta in cells (negative shrinks it).

damageMul.description: Multiplies damage after every additive mod (Hailstorm's 45%).

slowMul.description: Additive delta to the speed multiplier a hit applies (base: the projectile's slowMul, or 1 = no slow). Negative = colder.

shots.description: Additional projectiles per volley, each at full stats, sprayed by spread.

spread.description: Cells of random aim scatter per extra shot (combat stream).

pierceCount.description: Additional enemies a shot passes into after its target (Bolt Piercing).

shieldMul.description: Additive bonus to damage dealt to shields (base 1; +1 = double).

slowedBonusMul.description: Additive bonus to this tower's damage against already-slowed enemies (base 1; +0.5 = +50%).

freezeEvery.description: Pulse towers: every Nth pulse applies a full freeze (speed 0) instead of the slow. 0 = never.

chainCount.description: Chain towers: additional bodies per arc.

chainReach.description: Chain towers: additional cells a hop may span.

beamWidth.description: Beam towers: additional cells of corridor width.

beamRampMax.description: Beam towers: additional multiplier at full heat.

auraDamage.description: Support towers: additive to the aura's damage multiplier.

auraRate.description: Support towers: additive to the aura's fire-rate multiplier.

auraRange.description: Support towers: cells of range the aura adds.

auraReach.description: Support towers: additional cells of reach.

auraProduction.description: Support towers: additive to the aura's production-rate multiplier.
